evals.prompt: how healthy is my Obsidian vault? anything too big or disconnected?
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/audit_wiki.py on the vault without reading the notes first, uses .wiki-health.json if present, and reports the four sections: summary, oversized files with a remedy-based fix each (logs get an archive plan that moves entries word for word), orphans with the exact link to add, broken links with corrections. Edits nothing and ends with a numbered checklist.

evals.prompt: audit the docs in this repo, the agent context is getting bloated
evals.expected_output: Runs the audit on the repo; flags CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md or subagent files over their tighter built-in budgets with a trim or move-to-references fix; if dated plans or archives swamp the report, reruns with --ignore and says so. Proposes splits from the outline without reading whole files. No edits before approval.

evals.prompt: apply steps 1 and 2 of the wiki health plan
evals.expected_output: After a plan exists: does only steps 1 and 2, moves archived text word for word without rewriting it, deletes no notes, reruns the audit and shows the summary line before and after.
